chunks: CUSTOMER SUPPORT KNOWLEDGE BASE Company: ShopEasy Online Store Version: 1.0 Last updated: November 2026 This document contains the official policies and answers used by the support assistant. Answers must be based only on the information in this document. SECTION 1: ACCOUNTS AND LOGIN Q: How do I reset my password? A: On the login page, click "Forgot password". Enter the email address linked to your account. You will receive a reset link within 10 minutes. The link expires after 24 hours. If you do not see the email, check your spam folder. Q: What if I no longer have access to my registered email? A: Contact support with your full name, registered phone number and the last order ID. The support team will verify your identity and update your email address. This usually takes 1 to 2 business days. Q: How do I change my account email address? A: Go to Settings, then Account, then Email. Enter the new email address and your current password, then confirm the change using the link sent to the new address. Q: How do I delete my account? A: Go to Settings, then Account, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent and removes your order history and saved addresses. Active orders must be completed or cancelled before an account can be deleted. Q: Why was my account locked? A: An account is locked for 30 minutes after five failed login attempts. Wait 30 minutes, then try again, or use "Forgot password" to set a new password. SECTION 2: ORDERS AND SHIPPING Q: How long does shipping take? A: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times exclude Sundays and public holidays. Delivery times start from the date the order is dispatched, not the date it is placed. Q: Do you ship internationally? A: We currently ship to India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada and the United Arab Emirates. International orders take 7 to 14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the customer and are not included in the order price. Q: How can I track my order? A: Go to My Orders and select the order. The tracking number and current status are shown there. Tracking details usually appear within 24 hours of dispatch. Q: What is the shipping cost? A: Standard shipping is free on orders above 499 rupees. Orders below 499 rupees have a standard shipping charge of 49 rupees. Express shipping costs 99 rupees for all orders. Q: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order? A: You can change the address only before the order is dispatched. Go to My Orders, select the order and choose Change address. Once the order has been dispatched, the address cannot be changed and you will need to contact the courier directly. Q: My order is late. What should I do? A: If your order has not arrived within 7 days after the expected delivery date, contact support with your order ID. We will investigate with the courier and, if the order is lost, we will send a replacement or issue a full refund. Q: Can I cancel my order? A: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are dispatched. Go to My Orders, select the order and choose Cancel. After dispatch, cancellation is not possible, but you can return the item once it is delivered. SECTION 3: RETURNS, EXCHANGES AND REFUNDS Q: What is your return policy? A: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, provided they are unused, in their original packaging and include all tags and accessories. Some items, such as innerwear, personal care products and customised goods, cannot be returned for hygiene or safety reasons. Q: How do I return an item? A: Go to My Orders, select the item and

delivery, provided they are unused, in their original packaging and include all tags and accessories. Some items, such as innerwear, personal care products and customised goods, cannot be returned for hygiene or safety reasons. Q: How do I return an item? A: Go to My Orders, select the item and choose Return. Select a reason and a pickup slot. A courier will collect the item from your address. You can also drop it at any partner store listed in the app. Q: How long does a refund take? A: Refunds are processed within 2 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. The amount appears in your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days, depending on your bank. Cash on delivery refunds are sent to your bank account or as store credit. Q: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it? A: Yes. Choose Exchange instead of Return when you request the return. The exchange is subject to stock availability in the size or colour you want. If the new item costs more, you pay the difference. If it costs less, the difference is refunded. Q: Who pays the return shipping cost? A: Return shipping is free if the item is defective, damaged or wrong. For other returns, a return shipping fee of 49 rupees is deducted from the refund. Report the problem within 48 hours of delivery through My Orders, with clear photos of the item and the packaging. Once verified, we will issue a full refund or send the correct item at no cost. SECTION 4: PAYMENTS AND GIFT CARDS Q: Which payment methods do you accept? A: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, digital wallets and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to 5,000 rupees. Q: Why was my payment declined? A: Payments can be declined because of an incorrect card detail, insufficient balance, a bank restriction on online transactions, or a limit set on your card. Check the details and try again, or use a different payment method. If the amount was debited but the order was not placed, it is refunded automatically within 7 business days. Q: Do you offer gift cards? A: Yes. Gift cards are available in amounts from 500 rupees to 10,000 rupees. They can be bought on the Gift Cards page and sent by email to any recipient. They cannot be exchanged for cash, except where the law requires it. Q: Can I use more than one gift card on the same order? A: Yes. You can apply up to three gift cards to a single order. Any remaining balance on a gift card is saved for future purchases. Q: How do I use a discount code? A: Enter the code in the Apply Coupon box at checkout before you pay. Each code has its own conditions, such as a minimum order value or an expiry date. Discount codes cannot be combined unless the code says otherwise. SECTION 5: PRODUCTS AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT Q: How do I check the size of a product? A: Each product page has a size guide. Measure the item you own that fits you well, and compare its measurements with the chart. If you are between sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size. Q: Is the product under warranty? A: Electronics carry a warranty of 1 year from the date of delivery, covering manufacturing defects. Clothing and accessories are not covered by warranty but are covered by the return policy. What should I do? A: Make sure the app is updated to the latest version. Then close the app completely, restart your phone and try again. If the problem continues, clear the app cache from your phone settings, or reinstall the app. Contact support if the crash still occurs. Q: I cannot receive OTP messages. What should I do? A: Check that your phone has network coverage and that the number is correct in your account. Make sure you have not blocked messages from our sender ID. Wait 2 minutes before requesting a new OTP. If you still do not receive it, use the Call me option. SECTION 6: COMPLAINTS AND ESCALATION Q: I want to make a complaint. A: We are sorry for the trouble. Please describe the problem and include your order ID. Complaints are reviewed by a human support specialist, who will contact you within 24 hours. Q: How do I speak to a human agent? A: Type "agent" in the chat or select Talk to a person. Our specialists are available from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., Monday to Saturday. Outside these hours, your request will be answered on the next business day. Q: What happens if I am not satisfied with the resolution? A: You can ask for your case to be reviewed by a senior

Q: What happens if I am not satisfied with the resolution? A: You can ask for your case to be reviewed by a senior support specialist. Reviews are completed within 3 business days. SECTION 7: GENERAL POLICIES Q: What are your customer support hours? A: The automated assistant is available 24 hours a day. Human support is available from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., Monday to Saturday. Q: How is my personal information used? A: We use your personal information only to process orders, provide support and improve our services. We do not sell your information to third parties. You can request a copy or deletion of your data by contacting support. Q: Do you have a physical store? A: We do not have physical stores. All purchases are made through our website and mobile app. Partner stores are listed in the app for returns drop-off only.
